name: Parties
description: Who is involved and what passes between them: 2-4 party cards (icon badge, name, role) and links that draw themselves card to card with an arrowhead and a label pill. Money links keep coins flowing along them, people links keep small people flowing, cut_at breaks a link (grey dashes and an accent slash, the flow stops), and one party can be hot (accent ring and badge). Use it when the story turns on a relationship or a flow of money between people, shops, companies, banks or officials: who pays whom, who takes whose customers, who stopped paying. Give it a box about 800 x 800 (600-900 wide, 500-1100 tall); 2 parties stack top and bottom (side by side in a wide box), 3 make a triangle, 4 a grid. Cards grow to fill a roomy box; text keeps 40 px (roles 34 px) and wraps at word boundaries; a box too small for the cards is laid out larger and scaled down as a whole.

parties.description: the parties, in reading order (with 3, the first is the top card)

id.description: short id the links refer to

name.description: who it is, e.g. City Bank (48-60 px, wraps to two lines when long)

role.description: one short line under the name, e.g. main lender (34-40 px, two lines when long)

at.description: Time the card lands: "line:3" or seconds from the clip start. Default: 0.45 s apart from the clip start. Nothing shows before the first card

hot.description: the one party that matters: accent ring and badge (use on at most one)

links.description: what passes between parties; two links between the same pair run side by side. With 4 parties the two diagonals cross in the middle and share its room: label at most one of them

from.description: id of the party it starts at

to.description: id of the party the arrow points to

label.description: what passes, on a pill near the middle, e.g. $2B loan (40 px, two lines when long; one or two short words read best)

flow.description: money = coins keep travelling along it, people = small people do, none = a plain arrow

at.description: Time the link starts drawing: "line:4" or seconds from the clip start

cut_at.description: Time the link breaks: it turns grey and dashed, an accent slash crosses it, the flow stops

layout.description: auto: 2 parties stack (side by side in a box at least 1.25x wider than tall), 3 a triangle, 4 a grid

color.description: colour of the hot party and the slash: theme token or CSS

ground.description: light: paper panel with ink text; dark: night panel with snow text
